name: Roman Villa
description: Each battle you enter, roll a 1d8. 1: Nothing, 2: Cannot use physical force, 3: Cannot use Fire, Water, Flying, or Ground energy, 4: Cannot use Rock, Steel, Ghost, or Psionic Energy, 5: Cannot use Weapons, 6: Cannot use empowered forms, 7: Cannot use defensive skills, 8: Cannot use Grass, Fairy, Dark, or Dragon Energy.

name: Gigeresque Horror
description: Sanity Mechanic. Start with 50 Sanity, each new room reduces sanity by 1d4. When Sanity hits 0, all enemies mutate and gain 30% extra Beast Level. Applies to the Boss.

name: Demon Lord Dungeon (Black and Gold Brick)
description: When entering battle, roll 1d20. If you roll 1 or 2, you are being watched by the Demon Lord. Increase all enemies' Beast Level by 50%. Does not apply to bosses. Restricts Pokemon rolls to [Dark] types, Primary or Secondary.

name: Swampy Jungle
description: Snakes, Mosquitoes, and more. Roll 1d20 each new room. If you roll 1 or 2 a random target is bitten and poisoned. Restricts Pokemon rolls to [Poison], [Bug], or [Grass] types, Primary or Secondary.

name: Forest
description: Roll each exploration roll twice and take the option with branching paths. If you roll a treasure, ignore this. Every 10 rooms explored requires resting and food.

name: Cavern
description: Must have a method to survive in the cold. Double stamina cost for everything.

name: Sky Islands
description: Must fly between rooms. Hermes Bands can only fly 5 rooms before needing to recharge for a while. Restricts Pokemon rolls to [Flying] type, Primary or Secondary.

name: Glacier Mountain
description: Must have a method to survive the cold. Triple stamina cost for everything. Restricts Pokemon rolls to [Dragon] and [Ice] types, Primary or Secondary. Can only travel 5 rooms before starvation sets in due to extreme cold.

name: Underground Sea
description: Must have a method of travelling on water. Restricts Pokemon rolls to [Water] type, Primary or Secondary.

name: Tropical Archipelago
description: Must have a method of travelling on water. Stamina restores quickly when resting. Roll 1d20 when entering a room (not a hallway); on 16+ find a Sitrus Berry that fully restores Health in a Rift, and there are no Beasts in the room even if there normally would be.

name: Wooden Mansion
description: Ghosts haunt the mansion. Roll 1d20 when entering a room (not a hallway); on a 1 immediately enter battle with a random Ghost-type Beast. Restricts Pokemon rolls to [Ghost] type, Primary or Secondary.

name: Volcanic Cavern
description: Must have a method to survive the heat. Triple stamina cost for everything. Restricts Pokemon rolls to [Fire], [Ground], or [Rock] types, Primary or Secondary. Can only travel 5 rooms before dehydration sets in due to extreme heat.
